notes.title: Fight Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35722898/156e56b2feea41ac1c289ba702a60fafc511b949.gif

New Fight Update, when a player is tackling with too much violence (i.e tackling a player without ball), a fight can now occur !

If you have no yellow card, 1% chance
If you have 1 yellow card, 5% chance
If you have 2 yellow cards, 25% chance


Also a lot of small bugfixes :)

notes.title: Ruck Update
notes.notes:
New version, featuring a new ruck system.


When a ruck is generated, tap A button to add players to the ruck.
If you tap A it will also force your players to push the ruck and you may get the ball.
An indicator show you if you are gaining control of the ruck.

Lots of other minor modifications.
-The game speed has been dramatically changed (faster)


Please send feedback to sensiblerugby@gmail.com

notes.title: Update version 0.51 - Multiplayers
notes.notes:
New version with the ability to play up to 4 players, you can play 3 against 1, 2 against 2, whichever you want.

Includes also some small minor enhancements:
 -Change to the scoreboard
 -Change of graphics for the main screen  (Thanks to Mathis Bernier)
